subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Produzir textos (comentários em fóruns, relatos pessoais, mensagens instantâneas, tweets, reportagens, histórias de ficção, blogues, entre outros), com o uso de estratégias de escrita (planejamento, produção de rascunho, revisão e edição final), apontando sonhos e projetos para o futuro (pessoal, da família, da comunidade ou do planeta).

components.description_pt: Planejar uma produção escrita considerando propósito e público-alvo antes do rascunho
components.description_en: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Redigir um texto em inglês expressando sonhos ou planos futuros usando um gênero apropriado
components.description_en: Draft a text in English expressing dreams or future plans using an appropriate genre
components.cc_component_description: State a clear point of view or opinion on a topic or text in an opinion piece

components.description_pt: Revisar um rascunho para fortalecer clareza, desenvolvimento e coerência para o público-alvo
components.description_en: Revise a draft to strengthen clarity, development, and coherence for the intended audience
components.cc_component_description: Revise a draft to strengthen clarity, development, and coherence for the intended audience

components.description_pt: Editar e preparar versão final de um texto em inglês para publicação ou compartilhamento
components.description_en: Edit and prepare a final version of a text in English for publication or sharing
components.cc_component_description: Use digital tools to produce and format a piece of writing for publication

cc_matches.description: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
Write opinion pieces on topics or texts, supporting a point of view with reasons.
Use technology, including the Internet, to produce and publish writing and link to and cite sources as well as to interact and collaborate with others, including linking to and citing sources.
